judged_text: expandable_first_post? drops the 'embedding is configured' condition entirely (previously SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present?) instead of replacing it with an EmbeddableHost-existence check. The invariant 'first post is expandable only when embedding is set up' is no longer enforced: a site that deletes all its hosts (or has orphaned TopicEmbed rows with no hosts) now shows the expandable-first-post UI for embedded topics, a behavior change not traceable to the admin-editing requirement.

The invariant 'first post is expandable only when embedding is set up' is no longer enforced: a site that deletes all its hosts (or has orphaned TopicEmbed rows with no hosts) now shows the expandable-first-post UI for embedded topics, a behavior change not traceable to the admin-editing requirement.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `Topic#expandable_first_post?` from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (app/models/topic.rb). Since `embeddable_hosts` site setting is removed and replaced by the `EmbeddableHost` model, this method no longer gates the UI behavior on embedding being configured (e.g., `EmbeddableHost.exists?`). As a result, any topic with a `TopicEmbed` row (`has_topic_embed?` true) will be considered expandable whenever `embed_truncate` is enabled, even if there are zero allowed hosts configured (or hosts were deleted). The updated spec structure also doesn't enforce the missing check because the 'blank host' case doesn't stub `has_topic_embed?` to true, so it can pass for unrelated reasons.
